title: Use a CSS selector
summary: A CSS selector describes elements by tags, classes or attributes. Keep it short and tied to a clear target.
introduction: A CSS selector describes elements by tags, classes or attributes. Keep it short and tied to a clear target. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
